description: A rule that now keeps a file's copies on usb disks leaves the copy Atoll made on a sata disk misplaced: atoll balance makes one on the usb disk, then sends the old one to the trash, as rebalance. The user's copy stays. With --move-originals, a dry run would move the user's copies too: that of c.mkv to the usb disk, while a.mkv has no other usb disk to go to.

tags_mode = "strict"

steps.query: SELECT disk_id, created_by, state FROM copies WHERE file_id = (SELECT id FROM files WHERE lpath = CAST('a.mkv' AS BLOB)) ORDER BY disk_id
SELECT CAST(f.lpath AS TEXT), c.disk_id, c.created_by, c.state FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id ORDER BY f.lpath, c.disk_id
SELECT disk_id, reason, size FROM trash
SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), state FROM files ORDER BY lpath
